'''Armen Mazlumian''' is a voice actor for the English [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} by [[TAJ Productions]]. From the [[S02|second]] through [[S05|fifth seasons]], he acted as the sound supervisor/final mixer and an ADR engineer. He also acted as the voice director beginning with ''[[The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon]]'', and during the [[S09|ninth]] and [[S10|tenth seasons]], until the dubbing was taken over by [[DuArt Film & Video]].
